_comment: Sprite studio settings (see tools/sprite_studio.gd). kit_folder = where the 3D models are; output_folder = where the building pictures go. For each building id from data/buildings.json: model = file in the kit, turn = quarter turns (0-3) so its front faces the camera, tiles = how many tiles wide it stands (default 1). TEMPORARY art, expected to be swapped: Kenney City Kit (Commercial) 2.1, CC0, from https://kenney.nl/assets/city-kit-commercial - a city kit, so there is no real farm or mill yet. Kits are not committed to Git; re-download into Sprites kit/ to re-run the studio on another computer.
